items.date_raw: September 26, 2024, effective on the date Order in Council 1271/2024 was approved and ordered
items.citation_text: Government of Ontario, Ministry of Health; Ontario.ca investigation report
items.verbatim_snippet: Eric Hanna was appointed Supervisor after investigator Janice Skot’s June 28, 2024 report made 16 recommendations, including appointing a supervisor.

items.date_raw: revokes Hanna’s appointment at the end of June 8, 2025
items.verbatim_snippet: Hanna’s appointment was subsequently revoked when he stepped down and a successor was appointed.

items.date_raw: June 9, 2025, effective date; the Order in Council was approved and ordered on June 5, 2025
items.citation_text: Government of Ontario, Ministry of Health; Ontario.ca Supervisor's Interim Report
items.verbatim_snippet: Carmine Stumpo was appointed to succeed Hanna and continue the supervisor’s duties.
